mode: dry-run against disposed spike graphs and candidate inventory; no production manifest
definition_of_done_scope: M0 planning artifact only under ADR-0017 owner waiver

rules.rule: A shippable candidate has an exact version or immutable revision, canonical source, checksum, minimal feature set, and lock graph.
Exact license files, notices, redistribution obligations, service terms, and commercial-use compatibility receive independent legal approval.
Check registry, RustSec, repository advisories, OS/vendor sources, and relevant transitive advisories; any current affected exact source blocks adoption.
rules.failure_action: reject exact source or disable capability

rules.rule: Registry and source origins are allowlisted; mutable Git branches, unclear binaries, private APIs, and unknown provenance are blocked.
Minimum/current macOS, Apple Silicon, toolchain/MSRV, signatures, entitlements, and product binary-size delta are measured for the exact integration.
The candidate passes feature-specific correctness, cancellation, bounded-resource, credential, logging, hostile-input, failure, and cleanup gates.
A release SBOM is generated reproducibly from the locked production build and reconciles with the embedded artifact graph.
Every candidate has engineering/security/legal owners, review date, advisory response SLA, replacement plan, and re-review trigger.
